cases.name: Jessica Barnes
cases.about:
Jessica Barnes was the oldest of five siblings. Her siblings — ages 12, 14, 16 and 18 — and her aunt attended the Oct. 2 press conference at Pendleton Town Hall along with Mayor Frank Crenshaw. "She was the oldest," Varvara said. "She was the one who helped me with them." A spokesperson for the family, Troy Styles of Blunt Force Media, described Jessica Barnes as strong and as a person of faith.

"She was a bold personality. She had dreams. She had ambition. Little by little, it was stripped away from her," Styles said.
cases.narrative:
On 9/20/2024, investigators from the Pendleton Police Department and SLED searched for Barnes and located her remains in a wooded area at Twin Lakes Park recreational area on Hartwell Lake in Pickens County, SC. Investigators believe her body was moved there from the Barnes' home on Laurel Drive in Pendleton, SC. 

Pendleton police allege Brandon admitted he used his arms to strangle Jessica to death on Aug. 2, in a Pendleton residence.
